note.en: The reference builds its own image tokens without the `content` field (the raw alt text) that markdown-it's image rule sets; rendering is identical because the `alt` attribute is built from the child tokens, so this is only a token representation difference.
note.zh: 参考包自行构造 image token 时没有写入 markdown-it image 规则会设置的 `content`（原始 alt 文本）；由于 `alt` 属性由子 token 生成，渲染结果完全一致，因此这只是 token 表示差异。

note.en: The current package treats a `0` dimension as unspecified and rejects sizes whose width and height are both `0` (Obsidian behavior), while the reference emits `width="0"` / `height="0"`; both outputs are valid.
note.zh: 当前包将 `0` 维度视为未指定，并拒绝宽高均为 `0` 的尺寸（Obsidian 行为），而参考包会输出 `width="0"` / `height="0"`；两种输出都合法。

note.en: The reference's number scanner accepts `%` anywhere, so `=5%0x3%0` produces the invalid dimension values `5%0` and `3%0`; the current package only accepts a single trailing `%` and leaves the malformed size literal.
note.zh: 参考包的数字扫描器接受任意位置的 `%`，因此 `=5%0x3%0` 会产生非法的尺寸值 `5%0` 和 `3%0`；当前包只接受单个末尾 `%`，并保留这段非法尺寸的字面文本。

note.en: The current package accepts any whitespace before the size specification, while the reference requires a literal space and therefore leaves `![Alt](image.png\t=100x200)` unrendered; the tab form is an intentional extension.
note.zh: 当前包接受尺寸规格前的任意空白，而参考包要求字面空格，因此 `![Alt](image.png\t=100x200)` 不会被参考包渲染；制表符形式是本包有意的扩展。

notes.en: Only the deprecated `legacyImgSize` variant is compared: `imgSize` (`![alt =100x200](url)`) and `obsidianImgSize` (`![alt|100x200](url)`) are extensions of this package with no equivalent in `markdown-it-imsize`.
notes.zh: 只对比已废弃的 `legacyImgSize` 变体：`imgSize`（`![alt =100x200](url)`）和 `obsidianImgSize`（`![alt|100x200](url)`）是本包的扩展，`markdown-it-imsize` 没有对应实现。

notes.en: The current package treats a dimension whose numeric value is `0` as unspecified and rejects a size whose width and height are both `0`; the reference emits the literal `0`. Tracked by the `zero-dimension-handling` issue.
notes.zh: 当前包将数值为 `0` 的维度视为未指定，并拒绝宽高均为 `0` 的尺寸；参考包会原样输出 `0`。归入 `zero-dimension-handling` issue。

notes.en: The current package accepts a single trailing `%` per dimension (the documented syntax); the reference's number scanner accepts `%` anywhere, so `=5%0x3%0` yields invalid dimension values. Tracked by the `percent-inside-dimension` issue.
notes.zh: 当前包对每个维度只接受一个末尾 `%`（文档中的语法）；参考包的数字扫描器接受任意位置的 `%`，因此 `=5%0x3%0` 会得到非法的尺寸值。归入 `percent-inside-dimension` issue。

notes.en: The current package accepts any whitespace before the size specification, while the reference requires a literal space (its check is `charCodeAt(pos - 1) === 0x20`); `tab-before-size` is therefore parsed by the current package only. Tracked by the `size-prefix-whitespace` issue.
notes.zh: 当前包接受尺寸规格前的任意空白，而参考包要求一个字面空格（其检查为 `charCodeAt(pos - 1) === 0x20`）；因此 `tab-before-size` 只有当前包会解析。归入 `size-prefix-whitespace` issue。

notes.en: The reference `autofill` option is not compared: it reads image files from disk (`image-size`) and its output depends on the filesystem.
notes.zh: 不对比参考包的 `autofill` 选项：它会从磁盘读取图片文件（`image-size`），输出依赖文件系统。

notes.en: Scaling: the reference image rule re-attempts `parseLinkLabel` for every `![` opener and parses every label again; malformed sizes fall back to the core image rule. markdown-it caches `skipToken` positions, so all series stay ~linear (no superlinear behavior was found in the upstream implementation).
notes.zh: 扩展性：参考包的图片规则会为每个 `![` 起始符重新尝试 `parseLinkLabel`，并再次解析每个 label；格式错误的尺寸会回退到核心 image 规则。markdown-it 会缓存 `skipToken` 位置，因此所有序列都保持近似线性（上游实现中未发现超线性行为）。
